name: Alpsee
kurzbeschreibung: The alpine valley of Berwang with its Bärenbad forest pool and mountain lakes offers families and hikers pure relaxation.
beschreibung:
Overview

The picturesque high valley around Berwang (1,336 m) lies nestled in the majestic scenery of the Lechtal Alps and the Zugspitz chain, making it the highest municipality in the Tiroler Zugspitz Arena. The sunny region charms nature enthusiasts with rushing mountain streams, lush pastures, and clear alpine waters such as Rotlechstausee and popular bathing lake Bichlbach in the adjacent valley basin. In Berwang village center, visitors find the traditional forest swimming pool "Bärenbad" – a heated open-air bath with stainless-steel pools, a children's paddling pool, and generous sunbathing lawns. Together with surrounding mountain lakes, cascading waterfalls, and rich peatlands, the Berwang high valley forms an invigorating summer haven for families, hikers, and nature seekers away from busy crowds.

Route & Requirements

A wide trail network of easy walking paths, themed nature trails, and ambitious mountain tours extends across Berwang. A particularly enjoyable family walk leads from Berwang along the bubbling Rotlech stream down to the romantic Rotlech waterfall and onwards to the emerald-green Rotlechstausee (approx. two hours walking time, around 150 meters of elevation change). The paths follow well-maintained forest tracks and wide shaded woodland trails requiring standard fitness; many sections can easily be managed with strollers. Comfortable walking shoes with grippy profiled soles are perfectly adequate for valley trails. Routes are comprehensively signposted and offer scenic rest benches along forest edges overlooking the valley and craggy mountain peaks. For ambitious mountaineers, local peak Thaneller (2,341 m) or routes to Heiterwanger Hochalm provide challenging ascents with sweeping vistas across the Zugspitze massif.

Visit & Arrival

Berwang walking trails and natural lakes are accessible year-round free of charge. Bärenbad Berwang opens its doors in the warm summer months from June to early September daily from 09:30 to 19:00. Motorists arrive toll-free from Germany via the A7 and Reutte or via Garmisch-Partenkirchen and Ehrwald; turn off the B179 Fernpass road at Bichlbach onto the L21 toward Berwang. Ample free parking is provided in the village center. Train passengers take the Außerfernbahn to Bichlbach-Berwang station and connect via local guest buses.

Tips

Combine a relaxing hike to wild Rotlech Gorge with a refreshing afternoon at heated Bärenbad. Children will love the long bear water slide and expansive adventure playgrounds in the village center.
preis: Hiking trails free; Bärenbad Berwang day ticket adults approx. €6.50 (children reduced)
oeffnungszeiten: Hiking paths open year-round; Bärenbad open June to early September daily 09:30 to 19:00
